title: Update the termal_name_source_root description to say a rename or clear seals the private source identity
outcome: The termal_name_source_root tool description no longer says a rename or clear seals the old root's revision. It describes the private source identity that new naming seals, without showing the identity value. The matching assertion in the unknown-fields test is updated to that wording.
acceptance: src/delegation_mcp_source_root.rs no longer says that a rename or clear seals the old root's revision. The description says a private source identity is kept, and shows no source_id value.
The matching assertion text in src/tests/engram_source_root_unknown_fields.rs is updated, and that test passes.
